# Angel Tattooz Knowledge Base

## Business Identity & Relocation
Angel Tattooz is a premium tattoo studio located in North London.
We have recently relocated! Our new address is:
Studio A, 15 Station Parade, Cockfosters, Barnet, EN4 0DL (Next to Cockfosters Tube Station).
Contact: Ink@angeltattooz.co.uk | 020 8216 3400
Website: https://www.angeltattooz.co.uk

## Artist Specialties
Our highly skilled artists specialize in:
- Cover-up Tattoos
- Black and Grey Realism
- Fine Line
- Script & Lettering
- Traditional Tattoos
- Japanese Sleeve Tattoos

## Booking Procedure
To secure an appointment for a tattoo session, we require a £50 deposit.
Consultations are free, and we also accommodate walk-in consultation hours.
Our opening hours:
Monday - Saturday: 11:30 AM - 7:00 PM
Sunday: Closed / Appointments Only

## Hygiene, Health & Aftercare
Angel Tattooz strictly adheres to local health authority licensing and hygiene standards. We use top-quality equipment and premium inks to ensure safety and precision.
Aftercare: Leave the bandage on for 2-4 hours. Wash gently with antibacterial soap. Apply a thin layer of recommended aftercare ointment for the first few days, then switch to a fragrance-free lotion until fully healed.

## FAQs
Q: How much does a tattoo cost?
A: Pricing depends on the size, detail, and placement. We require a £50 deposit to secure tattoo sessions.

Q: Do you do cover-ups?
A: Yes! Our artists specialize in cover-up tattoos. We recommend booking a consultation to discuss the best design options for your cover-up.
